parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) and verify different behavioural properties — core state invariants vs. idempotency of the play-after-stop sequence. Near-duplicate test bodies are common when exercising overlapping preconditions from different semantic angles, and collapsing them would obscure the distinct intent of each test class. No production code is involved.
